chunks: And from a letter of his (peace be upon him and his family) to Mu'awiya.

key_terms.إِمَام عَلِي: Imam Ali, the first Imam in Shia Islam and the fourth Rashidun Caliph in Sunni Islam.
key_terms.مُعَاوِيَة: Mu'awiya, the Umayyad governor and later Caliph, recipient of the letter.
key_terms.نَهْجُ الْبَلَاغَة: Nahj al-Balagha, the collection of sermons, letters, and sayings of Imam Ali.

ai.seo_question: What is the first letter of Imam Ali to Muawiya in Nahj al-Balagha?
ai.summary: This heading introduces the seminal correspondence between Imam Ali (AS) and Mu'awiya during the First Fitna, serving as a diplomatic and theological discourse in Nahj al-Balagha. It highlights the contrast between Ali’s legitimacy based on divine appointment and Mu'awiya’s claim rooted in political power and Umayyad lineage. The letter sets the stage for Ali’s arguments regarding justice, prophetic succession, and the nature of authority in early Islam.
